<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at 5.2.2 -->

## What's Changed
### Enhancements 🚀
* Backport: Utilize partition pruning when calculating current collection project metrics by @nscuro in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/pull/8018
* Backport: Skip yearly NVD feed when modified feed covers time since last mirror by @nscuro in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/pull/8019
* Backport: v4-migrator: Drop FK constraints and indexes during load phase by @nscuro in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/pull/8024
### Bug Fixes 🐛
* Backport: Fix GHSA Rust ranges not being mapped to cargo versioning scheme by @nscuro in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/pull/8020
* Backport: Fix allowable values of `sortOrder` parameter in OpenAPI spec by @nscuro in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/pull/8021
* Backport: Delete EPSS feed temp file on failed download and set request timeout by @nscuro in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/pull/8022
* Backport: Fix CEL policies not taking analysis overrides into account by @nscuro in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/pull/8026
* Backport: Handle Red Hat Hummingbird distro versions by @nscuro in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/pull/8027
* Backport: Fix memory leak in RuntimeConfigMapper's schema cache by @nscuro in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/pull/8028
* Backport: Update default ENISA EU KEV Catalogue source and adapt EnisaKevEntry by @nscuro in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/pull/8029
* Backport: Followup: Incorporate recent ENISA KEV upstream changes by @nscuro in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/pull/8042
* Backport: Fix user sessions not being revoked on password change or suspension by @nscuro in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/pull/8043
### Dependency Updates 🤖
* Bump com.github.luben:zstd-jni from 1.5.7-23 to 1.5.7-24 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/pull/7794
* Bump tools.jackson:jackson-bom from 3.2.3 to 3.2.4 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/pull/7795
* Bump io.dropwizard.flywaydb:flyway-bom from 13.9.0 to 13.10.3 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/pull/7796
* Bump the codeql group with 2 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/pull/7797
* Bump oasdiff/oasdiff-action/breaking from 0.1.18 to 0.1.19 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/pull/7799
* Bump actions/setup-java from 6.0.1 to 6.1.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/pull/7800
* Bump zizmorcore/zizmor-action from 0.6.4 to 0.7.1 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/pull/7801
* Bump com.fasterxml.jackson:jackson-bom from 2.22.3 to 2.22.4 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/pull/7798
* Bump eclipse-temurin from `3fd2d24` to `1e20ead` in /apiserver/src/main/docker by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/pull/7811
* Bump com.squareup.okhttp3:okhttp-jvm from 5.5.0 to 5.5.1 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/pull/7812

# OWASP Dependency-Track Dependency-Track is an intelligent Component Analysis platform that allows organizations to identify and reduce risk in the software supply chain. Dependency-Track takes a unique and highly beneficial approach by leveraging the capabilities of Software Bill of Materials (SBOM).
